description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Dev10 provides immersive training and a pathway into software development for people building on technical skills or professional experience. Participants develop technical skills through training in technologies such as Java, MySQL, Spring, JavaScript, and React, then gain two years of client project experience.
Entry-Level Software Developer building software development skills through technical training and client project experience

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree
• Programming experience (6+ months) shown on your resume from academic coursework, personal projects, or professional work. You must have programmed within the last 3 months
• A recent STEM degree (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline)
• 12+ months of professional work experience in finance, healthcare, banking, insurance, hospitality, aviation, or tech, with no more than a 12-month gap since you last held that professional role
• Strong logic and reasoning skills
• Clear communication and collaboration abilities

Preferred:
• Passion for learning and interest in Software Development
• Team-oriented mindset
